string-array.name: legal_consent_bullets
string-array.item: The AI can make mistakes. Treat its output as a draft and verify before acting on anything with real-world consequences (messages, calls, purchases, deletes, settings changes).
Once you grant the agent permissions, it can send messages, place calls, install or uninstall apps, delete files, and modify system settings on your device.
Your chats, screenshots, and API keys stay on your device. The App does not upload them anywhere; there is nothing on our side to delete.
Third-party backends (Samosa AI or a User-Provided Provider you configure yourself) have their own terms and data-retention practices, which apply once a request leaves your phone.
You must use the App lawfully — no hacking, fraud, harassment, illegal activity, or infringement of others\' rights. You are responsible for any damage to your device or data.

Gotcha needs the Phone permission to dial the number you asked it to call. It only places calls you ask for, and the dialer stays on screen while it does.
Gotcha needs the SMS permission to send the message you asked for. Nothing is sent that you haven\'t asked it to send.
Gotcha needs to read your inbox to answer this — for example to find a code or a message someone sent you. Messages stay on the device unless you ask Gotcha to do something with them.
Gotcha needs your call history to answer questions about who called and when.
Gotcha needs your contacts to turn a name into a number — so \"call Priya\" reaches the right Priya.
Gotcha needs permission to save this contact to your address book.
Gotcha needs your calendar to see what\'s on your schedule.
Gotcha needs calendar access to create or change the event you asked for.
Gotcha needs the camera to take the photo you asked for.
Gotcha needs the microphone to hear you — for voice input, recording, and the \"Hey Gotcha\" wake word.
Gotcha needs your location to answer this — weather, what\'s nearby, or where you are right now.

Gotcha needs access to your photos to open the image you pointed it at.
Gotcha needs storage access to open the file you pointed it at.
Gotcha needs notification permission to alert you when a reply or a message arrives.
On a dual-SIM phone, Gotcha needs to read the phone state to pick which SIM places the call or sends the message.
